title: Open Jam @ Bear's on Fairfield
event_description: Neighborhood open jam session featuring indie rock, hip-hop, songwriters and more. Showcase for local talent and emerging artists. Great opportunity to collaborate with fellow musicians in Shreveport's Highland community.
event_venue_information:
Live Music Venue and Community Hub

Bear's on Fairfield is one of Shreveport's premier neighborhood live music venues located in the historic Highland/Stoner Hill area just south of downtown. This locally owned establishment reopened in 2017 and has established itself as a cultural center for local visual and musical artists. The venue features great sound equipment and professional sound engineers.

Weekly Events and Entertainment

Bear's hosts a diverse range of weekly events including open jams on Thursday nights featuring indie rock, hip-hop, songwriters and more. The venue regularly presents live local music on Friday and Saturday nights. The establishment also features karaoke and trivia nights throughout the week.

Venue Features

The venue is known for its welcoming atmosphere featuring locally produced art adorning its walls. Bear's offers a full menu of carefully crafted food and drinks including handcrafted cocktails, wines, and spirits. The bacon-wrapped hot dog and cheeseburgers are customer favorites. The venue operates as a safe late-night environment supporting a diverse community of musicians and artists.

Cultural Significance

Bear's has become a cornerstone venue in the Highland neighborhood supporting DIY music spaces. The owner Colton Johnson is a dedicated supporter of local artists and provides them with quality stage production, sound engineering, and development opportunities. The venue hosts Bear's Fest annually in May featuring live music bands, DJs, and vendors.

title: Open Mic @ The Historic Korner Lounge
event_description: Comedy and live music open mic night in downtown Shreveport. Thursday evening showcase welcoming performers of all levels. Sign-up begins at 7pm with happy hour specials available until 8pm.
event_venue_information:
Historic Downtown Entertainment Venue

The Historic Korner Lounge is a legendary downtown Shreveport venue located on Louisiana Avenue in the heart of the city's cultural district. This historic establishment has become a vibrant hub for entertainment and live performances with legendary vibes and community energy.

Weekly Entertainment Programming

The Korner Lounge hosts open mic comedy nights on Thursdays at 8:00 PM with sign-up starting at 7:00 PM. Sunday nights feature karaoke with the mic turning on at 7:00 PM. Both events are free to attend with no cover charge just good vibes and great tunes. Happy hour runs from 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM daily with drink specials.

Venue Atmosphere and Hours

The Historic Korner Lounge operates from 5:00 PM to 12:00 AM most evenings providing an open and welcoming atmosphere for all performers and audience members. The venue features quality sound systems and stage setup for live entertainment. Patrons can enjoy cocktails and refreshments while experiencing local talent.

Community Impact

As a downtown venue the Korner Lounge plays an important role in Shreveport's entertainment and cultural scene. It provides a stage for emerging comedians musicians and performers to develop their craft and connect with audiences. The venue's commitment to free or low-cost entertainment makes it accessible to a broad community audience.

title: Live Music @ Louisiana Grandstand
event_description: Intimate listening room experience featuring American Roots Music. Nightly live performances and seasonal showcases. Regional and touring artists. Listening first atmosphere with acoustics-first environment emphasizing songwriting and musicianship.
event_venue_information:
Historic Music Venue and Cultural Center

The Louisiana Grandstand is housed in the historic Woman's Department Club building erected in 1925 as a clubhouse for prominent ladies in the community. This beautiful restored historic landmark known as the Lady on Line is located at the corner of Line Avenue and Margaret Place in the Highland/Stoner area just south of downtown.

Venue Spaces and Capacity

Louisiana Grandstand operates two intimate music spaces: the Legendary Listening Room with 400 capacity and The Listening Lounge with 75 capacity. Both spaces are designed for acoustics-first intimate performances. The theaters feature some of the best headlining shows in the region and are considered among the oldest continuously operating theaters in Northwest Louisiana alongside the famous Strand Theater downtown.

Performance Style and Programming

Louisiana Grandstand has earned a reputation for fostering American Roots music and local artist development. The venue hosts a diverse range of touring artists while requiring that major bookings include local Shreveport musicians as show openers. Each event emphasizes storytelling songwriting and live musicianship in an up-close personal theater environment. Many shows include video presentations to enhance the visual experience.

Community and Artist Development

The venue partners with the Woman's Department Club and has been actively restored since 2020 with roof replacement and cosmetic repairs. Louisiana Grandstand provides local musicians with studio time and production resources through its onsite recording studio. The Artist Ambassador Program pairs established mentors with emerging local artists. The venue's mission echoes the legendary Louisiana Hayride which launched careers of Elvis Presley Hank Williams Johnny Cash and many other music icons.

Facilities and Services

The venue offers an upstairs concession area and mobile app for ordering food and drinks to your seat at no additional charge. Patrons enjoy validated parking and quality amenities. Staff are known for personable and attentive hospitality creating a welcoming atmosphere for all guests.

title: Shreveport Blues Festival
event_description: Annual blues festival celebrating Southern soul and blues music with multiple regional and national artists. Part of the city's strong blues heritage continuing the musical legacy of the Louisiana Hayride era.
venue_address: 2000 Brookshire Arena Drive Bossier City LA 71112
event_venue_information:
Premier Arena Venue in Northwest Louisiana

Brookshire Grocery Arena is one of Louisiana's premier concert and event venues. Located on the banks of the Red River in Bossier City this state-of-the-art facility features 270,000 square feet of space capable of hosting up to 14,000 patrons. Since opening in 2000 it has established itself as one of the top entertainment destinations in the South.

Event Programming and Capacity

The arena hosts world-class concerts family shows ice skating shows motor sports rodeos conventions religious events and community programs. It is home to major productions including the Shreveport Blues Festival and Winter Fest celebration. The facility features modern acoustics and production capabilities for large-scale entertainment experiences.

Location and Accessibility

Conveniently located near the Shreveport-Bossier entertainment district the arena provides easy access from hotels casinos and dining options. The venue is managed by ASM Global an international leader in venue and event strategy and management with portfolio spanning over 300 venues across five continents.
